Over the span [mark+131, mark+191] on A: O: [ovl1018] draw-dirty evictions >= 0.6 x Finish sd per frame and txr dl + scdl + range fin <= 0.3 x Finish sd. K: txr dl + scdl >= 0.6 x Finish sd.
